name: Grilled Chicken Thighs with Corn & Mango-Cucumber Salad (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
3 ear corn
1 mango
1 English cucumber
1 heart romaine hearts
½ small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the marinade, and turn to coat. Set aside.
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, remove and discard outer husks and silk from corn. Using your hands, snap each ear in half (you can also cut them in half crosswise with a knife).
Once the water is boiling, uncover the pot and reduce heat to medium; use tongs to lower the corn into the water and cook until just tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the corn is cooking, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add chicken (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and grill until lightly charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp white wine vinegar
½ tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh. Set aside a ½-cup for the kids plates, then add remaining mango to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Set aside a ½-cup for the kids plates, then add remaining cucumber to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop leaves. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To cut the corn off the cobs for the kids, stand corn upright on a cutting board; carefully cut kernels off the sides of the cobs. (Leave adult cobs whole if desired.)

FOR THE KID PLATES: Cut two chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces, then divide between plates along with mango, cucumber, and corn. Drizzle corn with a small amount of oil. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining chicken, salad, and corn on the cob between plates. Drizzle corn with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper
